findings.observed: The selected material is a solid opaque pale-gold rectangle. Its artwork, name and rules are completely hidden; only the return arrow remains visible. The source card and unselected shelf remain readable.
findings.source: battle.infusion-view.js renders the selected physical card face, then an independent return arrow. battle-infusion.css applies a 3px gold outline with transparent interior.
findings.causeAtCapture: BattlePresentation.SyncInfusionWorkspace appends a full White-sprite Image with Color.clear and Outline.useGraphicAlpha=false above the selected face. Outline copies the full rectangle as opaque gold, covering the face instead of drawing a hollow perimeter.
findings.recommendation: Use four narrow non-interactive edge images or an actual hollow border sprite. Preserve the face interior and return action. Recheck the selected real-infusion frame after the fix.
findings.notification: Reported immediately to root and battle author after view_image. Root confirmed the actual screenshot and dispatched a minimal hollow-border correction.
findings.closure: Individually inspected player-4/player-infusion-picked.png with view_image. Four narrow gold edges leave the full selected starter artwork, name and rule text visible. The return arrow remains visible at lower right; no opaque interior rectangle covers the card.
findings.finalPackageRecheck: Reconfirmed with view_image on player-5/player-infusion-picked.png: selected artwork, name, rule and return arrow remain readable inside the hollow border.

findings.observed: At 1/1 selected, the unselected candidate shelf remains fully bright.
findings.source: infusionMaterialState returns canAdjust=false for unpicked cards when the infusion is full; renderInfusionSelection applies infusion-at-limit, whose final CSS sets opacity .6.
findings.unityAtCapture: HandPanel sets Off from fuelAllowed and ApplyPose selects alpha from Off only, so eligible full-draft candidates remain alpha 1.
findings.recommendation: Apply the .6 presentation only to full real-infusion candidates, including pose/hover updates. Ordinary RuleHandSelection deliberately keeps other eligible faces bright when its draft is full.
findings.closure: Individually inspected player-4/player-infusion.png and player-infusion-picked.png with view_image. At 1/1 the remaining candidate shelf is visibly faded while source and selected card remain bright/readable. The ordinary hand-selection picked image keeps other eligible faces bright. Current HandPanel SyncOpacity applies InfusionAtLimit=.6 only to real infusion, and shares it across hover/pose updates; the still image confirms that presentation state rather than independently measuring exact alpha.
findings.finalPackageRecheck: Reconfirmed with view_image on player-5/player-infusion-picked.png that the 1/1 unpicked shelf is faded; player-infusion-return.png restores the ordinary hand, arena actors/labels, foreground and HUD without remaining blur or dimming.
